topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: On-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation by limiting buffer size, affecting time-tagged services. Prioritizing these services reduces retransmissions, minimizing power consumption. Data compression and error correction codes optimize power allocation, while adaptive modulation adapts to channel conditions, ensuring efficient transmission and buffer management.
reference_context: On-board memory constraints limit data packet storage, impacting time-tagged services and power allocation, with technological features and constraints affecting satellite communication systems.
